title: Agar Plating Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Transfer samples to agar plates
steps.instruction: Move up to 96 samples to their corresponding positions on up to 9 agar plates, changing tips between each different sample to prevent contamination; optionally puncture each agar plate before dispensing the sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each sample to its designated location on the agar plate (maximum 96 samples, up to 9 source plates).
Replace the tip after each sample transfer to avoid cross‑contamination.
If desired, puncture the agar surface before dispensing the sample.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol files and unzip them if they are compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select the required .json labware files, if any are needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol Python file
steps.instruction: In the OT App’s Protocol tab, upload the protocol file with a .py extension.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck hardware to match the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware, tiprack, and pipette
steps.instruction: Use the OT App to calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette; consult the support articles for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Execute the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the protocol.
